MgmtSpaceAppRole.description:
What a Space–App link is. 0.6.0 writes only `governing` (one per Space, the
Space's `app_id`).

oneOf.description: The App the Space is bound to; it may govern the Space (`governance: app`).
An App that takes part in the Space without governing it (0.7.0).
Sew's own model: roles, overwrites and membership are edited in Sew (the default).
The governing App decides membership, private channels and levels (K2's sync).

The server-governed Space (named `K5 Space`), one per K2 install, owned by `k2:server`:
K2's daemon decides its structure over mgmt; no App session ever reaches it.

description:
Answer of `GET /mgmt/v1/spaces/{space_id}/apps`: the Space's App links, the
governing one first.

items.description: Its links (empty for an unbound Space).

title: MgmtSpaceApps
